P2.title: Finish context teardown before closing its browser
P2.issue: Promise.allSettled starts context.close and browser.close concurrently. BrowserContext.close disposes its request context and later closes its channel; installed Playwright does not swallow target-closed at the latter step, so concurrent parent browser shutdown can reject. Actual receipt cleanup is FAIL. Per-action reasons were not retained, so the original failure cannot independently prove that race was its sole cleanup cause.
P2.fix: Await context cleanup settlements before browser close, then disconnect database clients; preserve cleanup rejection as FAIL and keep sanitized per-action outcomes if useful. Do not make cleanup failure automatically pass.
